task.title: Importing OPC UA Histories without using a control point
task.shortdesc: The OpcUaDevice component’s histories extension (OpcUaClientHistoryDeviceExt can import OPC UA histories without creating a control point.

context.note: Be aware that you can duplicate an OPC UA history import by unintentionally using both the OpcUaClientHistoryImport component and a control point with an ImportHistoryExt for the same discovered object. Refer to “Adding points containing OPC UA histories.”

step.cmd: In the Nav tree, right-click on Histories under the OpcUaDevice and click ViewsOpc Ua Client History Import Manager.
In the view, click Discover and wait a few moments for the job to run.
step.stepresult: On completion, the discovery job displays a list of histories in the Discovered pane.

step.cmd: Select one or more histories to be imported and click Add.
Modify properties to set up the history import as desired and click OK.

taskbody.result: The driver imports the histories to the station’s history database at the time specified in the Execution Time property.
